data.spiritual_significance: The name Halonna conveys both the physical and spiritual elements of strength and grace. Rooted in the Hebrew meaning of 'rock', this name symbolizes the unwavering foundation and security that one may find in God. This name serves as a reminder of the strength found in the rock of salvation and the enlightenment granted by God's divine grace.
